title: Demand Service Rate Programs: Trip, Diagnostic, Parts and Refrigerant Schedule
content:
1. **Trip charge.** The trip charge is the charge added to each dispatched call under the Demand Service Rate Programs, in US dollars.
2. **Diagnostic fee.** The diagnostic fee is the fee charged when a technician is dispatched to find a
   fault, in US dollars. The credited column states whether that fee is credited against the repair when
   the repair is authorised on the same visit.
3. **Parts.** The markup is the markup applied to the contractor's parts cost when parts are billed, in
   percent; the parts discount is the discount from list price applied to parts under that program, in
   percent.
4. **Refrigerant.** The refrigerant figure is the rate billed for refrigerant added on a demand call, in
   US dollars per pound.

| Program | Trip charge (USD) | Diagnostic fee (USD) | Diagnostic fee credited to the repair | Parts markup (percent) | Parts discount (percent) | Refrigerant (USD per pound) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Time & Material Account | 125 | 185 | No | 35 | 0 | 118 |
| Priority Response Program | 95 | 165 | Yes | 30 | 5 | 110 |
| Block Hour Service Program | 85 | 145 | Yes | 28 | 8 | 104 |
| Emergency Response Program | 0 | 125 | Yes | 25 | 10 | 98 |
| Critical Facility Response Program | 0 | 0 | Yes | 22 | 12 | 94 |
| Dedicated Technician Program | 0 | 0 | Yes | 18 | 15 | 88 |

*Note.* Where a figure in the trip or diagnostic column stands at 0, that program carries no such charge
at all: the Emergency Response Program, the Critical Facility Response Program and the Dedicated
Technician Program carry no trip charge, and the last two of those carry no diagnostic fee.
